build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNetBackbone model with a specified ResNet variant like 18, 50, or 101
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the ResNetBackbone with an optional stage parameter for early or late features
init_weights_imagenet: initialize the ResNetBackbone weights from ImageNet pretrained model zoo for resnet18 or resnet50
review_make_layer: review the _make_layer method that constructs ResNet blocks with optional downsampling for stride changes
refactor_forward_stage: refactor the forward method to support early stage extraction after conv1 and maxpool layers
